name: River Avon
text: The River Avon ( AY-vən) is a river in the southwest of England. To distinguish it from a number of other rivers of the same name, it is often called the Bristol Avon. The name 'Avon' is from an ancestor of the Welsh word afon, meaning 'river'.

depictions.text: River_Avon#England The River Avon, also known as the Afon River, is a river that flows around Hampshire to the south of Gloucestershire.
